claims.label: Host Says TPUSA Wikipedia Entry Was Updated at 10:34 PM ET on September 11, 2025 to Add Rob McCoy as Co-Founder of TPUSA Faith
claims.claim: The host says the TPUSA Wikipedia entry was updated at 10:34 PM Eastern on September 11, 2025 - less than 36 hours after Charlie Kirk's death - to add a heading naming Pastor Rob McCoy and Charlie Kirk as co-founders of TPUSA Faith.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain Wikipedia edit history (revision IDs, editor accounts, IP traces) for the TPUSA article between September 10–12, 2025, and compare to standard post-trauma edit patterns.

claims.label: Pre-Existing 2021 Wikipedia Entry Stated Charlie Kirk Founded TPUSA Faith Alone
claims.claim: Per the TPUSA Wikipedia article the host shows, before the September 11, 2025 update it contained a long-standing section (a 2021 version, which she reads) stating that Charlie Kirk founded TPUSA Faith, with no mention of Rob McCoy.
claims.investigative_direction: Retrieve archived snapshots of the TPUSA Wikipedia article (e.g., Wayback Machine, Wikipedia pre-September-2025 revisions) to verify the prior text.

claims.label: Citation Source for McCoy Co-Founder Claim Is Dated November 24, 2024 with Additional September 2025 Citations
claims.claim: The host says the citation used in the updated Wikipedia entry to support the assertion that Rob McCoy was co-founder and co-chairman of TPUSA Faith points to an article dated November 24, 2024, and that the second citations used are dated September 2025 (September 10th).
claims.investigative_direction: Locate and verify the cited article(s) by date and content; confirm whether the citation supports the assertion as labeled.

claims.label: November 24, 2024 Citation Article Does Not State McCoy Was Co-Founder or Chairman
claims.claim: The November 24, 2024 article cited as source for McCoy's "co-founder/co-chairman" status does not, per the host's reading, contain text stating that McCoy was a co-founder or chairman of TPUSA Faith.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the cited article directly and check for the phrases "co-founder," "chairman," "co-chairman," and any reference to TPUSA Faith.

claims.label: Host Says the Only Trump Truth Social Post Her Team Found on an 'Investigation' Was About Jack Smith's TPUSA Probe, Not Kirk's Murder
claims.claim: The host says her team searched Truth Social for Trump posts calling for further investigation into Charlie Kirk's murder and found only one, which she says is not a call for an investigation into the murder but asks why Turning Point was under investigation by Jack Smith and the Biden administration.
claims.investigative_direction: Retrieve the full archive of Trump's Truth Social posts (or host's saved search) to verify that no other posts reference the Kirk investigation directly.

claims.label: New York Times Article Reported Kash Patel Was Alarmed by Joe Kent's Inquiry About the Kirk Investigation
claims.claim: The host says a New York Times headline the day before concerned how upset Kash Patel was when he received an inquiry from Joe Kent, of Tulsi Gabbard's office, about details of the Charlie Kirk investigation, which apparently alarmed Patel; she suggests they were asking whether people overseas were involved.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate the NYT article by date, headline, and quoted material; confirm direct attribution to Patel and the substance of Kent's inquiry.

claims.label: Host Says Kash Patel Apparently Met With Wiles, Kent, Gabbard and, She Thinks, JD Vance on the Inquiry
claims.claim: The host says that, after the inquiry, Kash Patel apparently held a meeting with Susie Wiles, Joe Kent, Tulsi Gabbard and Trump officials, that she thinks it said JD Vance was also in the meeting, and that nothing was accomplished.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm via the NYT article whether these named officials were present and whether subsequent reporting describes any action items.

claims.label: Host Says Trump Established October 14 as a National Day of Remembrance for Charlie Kirk
claims.claim: The host says that for Charlie's birthday President Trump established a holiday, deciding that October 14 - Charlie Kirk's birthday - would be a national day of remembrance for Charlie Kirk.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate the relevant proclamation in the Federal Register or White House archive to confirm date, scope, and signing date.

claims.label: Don Trump Jr. Expressed Confidence in the FBI Kirk Investigation in a Megyn Kelly Interview
claims.claim: In a clip of a Megyn Kelly interview the host plays, Donald Trump Jr., asked whether he has confidence in the FBI investigation into Charlie Kirk's death, says after some hesitation ('I mean, I don't know') that he does have confidence.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the full Megyn Kelly interview clip and surrounding context; verify whether the confidence statement is unconditional or hedged.

claims.label: Don Trump Jr. Initially Deflected Before Being Pressed and Expressing Confidence
claims.claim: In a clip of the Megyn Kelly interview the host plays, Don Trump Jr., asked how he feels about the investigation into Charlie's death, says "so far so good" and turns to continuing Kirk's work; when Kelly asks again whether he has confidence in the FBI investigation, he says "I I do, you know, and I I I mean, I don't know," then that he does have confidence. The host says he did his best not to answer the question.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm sequence of statements in the unedited interview.

claims.label: Host Rejects Wikipedia Characterization of Rob McCoy as TPUSA Faith Co-Founder
claims.claim: The host asserts that Rob McCoy was not the founder or co-founder of TPUSA Faith but one of the advisers put on its advisory board; she says the idea for TPUSA Faith came from conversations with pastors back at Liberty University, which she was there for.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain contemporaneous TPUSA Faith formation documents, IRS filings, and founding board records to resolve.

claims.label: Host Characterizes Don Trump Jr.'s Confidence Statement as Inconsistent With What He Would Say If He Believed the Official Narrative
claims.claim: The host asks Don Trump Jr., as a hunter, to make a video saying he believes Charlie was shot in the neck with a .30-06 that his neck stopped while remaining intact, and says he will not say that because it is untrue.
claims.investigative_direction: This is interpretive host commentary; falsifiable only by further direct statement from Don Trump Jr. or by independent investigation into the wound-ballistics question.

claims.label: Norman Finkelstein Trailer Characterizes Gaza Treatment and "Jewish Supremacist" Money Influence
claims.claim: In a trailer for an upcoming interview with the host, Norman Finkelstein is shown saying The Economist described Gaza as 'a human rubbish heap' and the leading UN official on Gaza described it as 'a toxic dump for the people of Israel', and asserting that a billionaire class of Jewish supremacists is flagrantly using money as a blackmail weapon to silence not just criticism of Jews but criticism of an ongoing genocide.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the quoted Economist and UN official attributions against original publications; this claim is tangential to the Kirk investigation but is presented within the same episode.

claims.label: Host Says Charlie Was a Gifted Child Whose Parents Refused ADHD Medication
claims.claim: The host says that, from her memory, as a child Charlie Kirk was so gifted, and hyperactive, that doctors wanted to put him on ADHD medicine, that his parents refused and sent him to a school for the gifted, and that Charlie told her this story multiple times.
claims.investigative_direction: Ask the Kirk family or early associates to confirm the childhood schooling and the ADHD medication decision; look for school records or biographies that mention it.
claims.transcript_snippet: of course doctors immediately wanted to put him on ADHD medicine because well why is he so hyperactive?

claims.label: Host Believes Charlie Was Assigned Life Handlers After Gifted Schooling
claims.claim: The host says she truly believes Charlie Kirk was probably assigned 'life handlers' from the time he entered a school for gifted children, and speculates that standardized tests exist so the government can track high performers.
claims.investigative_direction: No document is cited; the claim is speculation and would need records of any monitoring programme tied to Kirk's schooling.
claims.transcript_snippet: I truly believe that he was probably assigned like life handlers from that moment on.

claims.label: Wikipedia Entry Text Says McCoy Co-Chaired TPUSA Faith and Inspired Kirk
claims.claim: The host reads the new Wikipedia entry as saying McCoy is co-chairman of TPUSA Faith, is a Pentecostal pastor in the Calvary Chapel Association, and inspired Kirk to amalgamate Christianity and social conservatism.
claims.investigative_direction: Pull the revision of the TPUSA Wikipedia article saved on 11 September 2025 and compare the exact wording and cited sources with what the host read.
claims.transcript_snippet: McCoy is the co-chairman of TPUs faith, aligned with the Christian right, McCoy inspired Kirk to amalgamate Christianity and social conservatism.

claims.label: Host Says Charlie Told Her TPUSA Had Found Someone to Clean Up Wikipedia Pages
claims.claim: The host says Charlie Kirk told her that Turning Point USA had found a person who could clean up Wikipedia pages, that organizations pay people to do this full time, and that she cannot yet recall who the person was.
claims.investigative_direction: Search the host's saved messages with Charlie Kirk for the Wikipedia-cleanup contact, and compare Wikipedia edit histories of TPUSA pages for paid-editor disclosures.
claims.transcript_snippet: I know he told me that they Turning Point USA's organization had found a guy that could help clean up the Wikipedia pages.

claims.label: Host Says Erika Kirk Had Not Yet Been Announced as Chair and CEO When the Edit Was Made
claims.claim: The host says that less than 36 hours after the shooting she does not think TPUSA had yet announced Erika Kirk as chairman and CEO, and does not think Charlie's body had returned to Arizona, yet someone had already added McCoy to Wikipedia.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare the Wikipedia edit timestamp of 10:34 PM ET on 11 September 2025 with the TPUSA announcement of Erika Kirk as CEO and with the date Kirk's body returned to Arizona.
claims.transcript_snippet: I don't even think they had even yet announced that Erika Kirk was the chairman and the CEO 36 hours later.

claims.label: Host Says McCoy Is Paid by TPUSA Faith for Upcoming Pastor Summits
claims.claim: The host says Rob McCoy was one of the advisers on the TPUSA Faith advisory board, that he gets paid by TPUSA Faith for its upcoming pastor summits, and that he would benefit financially from the direction the division was taking.
claims.investigative_direction: Request TPUSA Faith contracts, speaker agreements or IRS Form 990 compensation disclosures showing payments to McCoy.
claims.transcript_snippet: I know that he gets paid um by TP US faith upcoming uh pastor summits

claims.label: Host Says Trump Posted an AI Photo of Himself and Charlie With a Star of David
claims.claim: The host says that when Charlie Kirk died, Trump rushed to post on Truth Social an AI image of himself and Charlie with a Star of David in the background, and that she knew then the investigation was over.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate the original Truth Social post, its date and the image, and verify whether the image is AI generated and contains a Star of David.
claims.transcript_snippet: when Trump rushed to tweet out that or social truth social out that photo, that AI photo of him and Charlie with the star of David in the background.

claims.label: Host Says Pro-Israel Figures Were the Most Insistent That Questions About Charlie's Death Stop
claims.claim: The host says the people most insistent from the early hours that others stop asking about Charlie Kirk's death were those dedicated to the Israel lobby, and challenges viewers to find one real-life pro-Israel individual who says they don't believe Tyler Robinson killed Kirk, or one pro-Israel person with a platform who wants the investigation to continue.
claims.investigative_direction: Survey public statements by prominent pro-Israel commentators on the Robinson case to test the host's challenge.
claims.transcript_snippet: Find me one, just one real life pro-Israel individual who is expressing that they don't believe that Charlie Kirk was killed by Tyler Robinson.

claims.label: Host Says the Evidence Is Overwhelming That Robinson Did Not Act Alone, Fire the Shot or Use a .30-06
claims.claim: The host says the evidence is overwhelming that Tyler Robinson did not act alone, did not fire the shot and did not use a .30-06 rifle.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare the host's cited evidence with the charging documents, the ballistics report and the recovered rifle record.
claims.transcript_snippet: The evidence is overwhelming that Tyler Robinson didn't act alone, that Tyler Robinson didn't fire the shot, that Tyler Robinson didn't use a 30 odd six.

claims.label: Host Says TPUSA Clears About a Hundred Million Dollars a Year
claims.claim: The host says Turning Point USA is clearing about a hundred million dollars a year and still asks the public to give more.
claims.investigative_direction: Check TPUSA's Form 990 filings for total annual revenue and compare with the host's later figure of 70 million in the last year.
claims.transcript_snippet: Clearing like a hundred million a year. They don't have enough.

claims.label: Host Says the Feds Probably Killed Martin Luther King Jr.
claims.claim: The host says that when the feds line up to give someone a holiday it is never good, and that she thinks maybe the feds definitely killed Martin Luther King Jr.
claims.investigative_direction: Off-topic historical assertion recorded as said; no document is cited.
claims.transcript_snippet: I think maybe the feds definitely killed Martin Luther King Jr.

claims.label: Host Says Trump Told a Memorial Story About Charlie and Brilyn Hollyhand Although Trump Was Not There
claims.claim: The host says Trump, in his speech at Charlie Kirk's memorial, told a story about Charlie interviewing a fourth grader named Brilyn Hollyhand, that Trump was not present and that she herself was next to Charlie at that interview.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare the transcript of Trump's memorial speech with footage and dates of Charlie's interview with Brilyn Hollyhand to see who attended.
claims.transcript_snippet: Even Trump's speech, remember when he just kind of worked in the story about uh Charlie interviewing a fourth grader and he was referring to Brilyn Hollyhand?

claims.label: Host Says Kash Patel Attended Charlie's Memorial
claims.claim: The host says Kash Patel showed his face at Charlie Kirk's memorial, and says she would have died of shame before attending as Patel.
claims.investigative_direction: Check the memorial attendee list and event footage for Patel.
claims.transcript_snippet: I would pass away right immediately from shame before I would show up to that event if I was Kash Patel.

claims.label: Host Says Patel Limits the Kirk Case to a Very Small Team at the FBI
claims.claim: The host says Kash Patel has a very small team of people at the FBI who are allowed to touch anything pertaining to the Charlie Kirk case.
claims.investigative_direction: Request FBI organizational records or congressional testimony describing who has access to the Kirk case file.
claims.transcript_snippet: he's got a very small team of people at the FBI that are allowed to touch anything pertaining to the Charlie Kirk case

claims.label: Host Says She Suspects Foreign Entities Were Involved and Is Getting Close
claims.claim: The host says that she thinks they are getting very close to what actually happened on that day, that she is getting the suspicion that there were some foreign entities involved, and asks Joe Kent and Tulsi Gabbard to keep going.
claims.investigative_direction: Ask the host to identify the evidence behind the suspicion of foreign involvement, and compare with the Kent inquiry reported by the New York Times.
claims.transcript_snippet: I'm getting the suspicion that there were some foreign entities involved.

claims.label: Host Says Mikey McCoy and Kolvet Were Absent From the Charlie Kirk Show
claims.claim: The host says Mikey McCoy, who took the seat after Charlie, is missing from the Charlie Kirk Show and that Andrew Kolvet was missing from the episode of that day.
claims.investigative_direction: Check the Charlie Kirk Show episode listing and host roster for the date of this episode.
claims.transcript_snippet: Mikey McCoy is missing um from the Charlie Kirk show.

claims.label: Host Relays Kolvet's Account That Charlie Said Not to Help Him If Shot in the Neck
claims.claim: The host says Andrew Kolvet told people Charlie was explicit that if he was ever shot at an event in the left side of the neck, the first thing he wanted was for people not to help him.
claims.investigative_direction: Find Kolvet's original statement and who heard Charlie say it; ask security and staff whether any such instruction existed.
claims.transcript_snippet: Charlie said, "If I ever get shot at an event, the left side of my neck, the first thing I want you to do is not help me."

claims.label: Host Says Charlie Was Given No First Aid and the Wound Was Not Secured
claims.claim: The host says Charlie Kirk was not administered any first aid, that she has close-up videos of this, and that no gauze was applied and the wound was not secured as they carried him to the hospital.
claims.investigative_direction: Review the close-up videos and medical records and interview the security team on first aid steps taken before transport.
claims.transcript_snippet: He was not administered any first aid. I have the close-up videos of that.

claims.label: Host Says Alex Clark Released an Interview in Which Kolvet Said Charlie and Erika Were Committed Evangelicals
claims.claim: The host says Alex Clark released an interview with Andrew Kolvet a couple of days after the memorial in which they said Charlie and Erika were committed evangelicals and that he liked the smells and bells and the architecture but there was no more substance for him.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate the Alex Clark interview and check what Kolvet and Erika Kirk said about Catholicism.
claims.transcript_snippet: Alex Clark released that interview with her and Andrew Kolvet and they struggle sessioned through that.

claims.label: Host Says Operation Mocking Pastor Figures Denied the Catholic Point
claims.claim: The host says that after she mildly said Charlie was close to converting, accounts she calls Operation Mocking Pastor or mocking evangelical influencers went out saying it was not true.
claims.investigative_direction: Collect the public denials from evangelical influencers and compare dates with the host's earlier statements.
claims.transcript_snippet: operation mocking pastor or mocking evangelical influencer went out and they all were like, "That's not true.

claims.label: Host Says Charlie Had a Catholic Funeral Mass and Is Buried in a Catholic Cemetery
claims.claim: The host says the reason there has been no burial coverage is that Charlie Kirk had a Catholic funeral mass and is buried in a Catholic cemetery.
claims.investigative_direction: Check parish and cemetery records, the funeral program and public notices for the rite and burial location.
claims.transcript_snippet: Charlie had a Catholic funeral mass and he is buried in a Catholic cemetery.

claims.label: Host Says Bob Shillman Took $2 Million Away and TPUSA Brought In 70 Million Last Year
claims.claim: The host says donor Bob Shillman took 2 million dollars away from Turning Point USA and that, by her account, the organization brought in 70 million dollars last year, questioning whether the donors Kolvet called a small portion cut the bigger checks.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain TPUSA's Form 990 and donor records for the year and verify the 70 million total and the 2 million withdrawal.
claims.transcript_snippet: Like Bob Shillman took $2 million away. That's got to mean something.

claims.label: Host Says Donors Are Pressuring TPUSA Staff to Maintain That Charlie Died Pro-Israel
claims.claim: The host says she thinks donors have insisted and are pressuring TPUSA people, as she is hearing, to maintain the idea that Charlie died pro-Israel.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the sources the host says she is hearing from and any messages from donors asking TPUSA to maintain a pro-Israel framing.
claims.transcript_snippet: I think they insisted and are pressuring them as we are hearing to maintain the idea that Charlie died pro-Israel.

claims.label: Host Says Don Jr. Helped Build Turning Point USA and Did Campus Events With Her and Charlie
claims.claim: The host says Donald Trump Jr. was one of the people who very much helped to build Turning Point USA, did a ton of college campus events with her and Charlie, and was probably without question the most committed Trump family member to TPUSA's early story.
claims.investigative_direction: Check TPUSA campus event schedules and photos from 2016 to 2018 for Don Jr. appearances.
claims.transcript_snippet: Don Jr., by the way, I would say was one of the people who very much helped to build Turning Point USA.

claims.label: Don Jr. Says He Has Spoken to Erika and Others and Does Have Confidence
claims.claim: In the Megyn Kelly clip Don Jr. says, after 'I mean, I don't know', that he has spoken to everyone around, including Erika, and that he does have confidence in the FBI investigation.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the unedited Kelly interview and ask Don Jr. which people and what information he based his confidence on.
claims.transcript_snippet: but I've spoken to everyone, you know, around and, you know, Erika and like like I I I do have confidence

claims.label: Don Jr. Says a Cottage Industry Profiteers Off Conspiracy Theories
claims.claim: In the same clip Don Jr. says there is a cottage industry of clicks and people happy to profiteer off conspiracy theories, that some of it goes off the rails, and that it has been used by the other side as a distraction.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the full clip and ask which accounts or claims Don Jr. meant by the cottage industry.
claims.transcript_snippet: there there is a cottage industry of just clicks and people that are more than happy to you know to profiteer you know off of that.

claims.label: Host Says Don Jr. Was Vocal About the Epstein Files Until His Father Asked If They Were Still Talking About Epstein
claims.claim: The host says Don Jr. was one of the most vocal people about the Jeffrey Epstein files until his father said, 'Are we still talking about Jeffrey Epstein?'
claims.investigative_direction: Compare Don Jr.'s public posts on the Epstein files over time with Trump's remarks.
claims.transcript_snippet: He was actually one of the people that was the most vocal about the Jeffrey Epste files until dad said, "Are we still talking about Jeffrey Epstein?"

claims.label: Host Recounts Fishing With Don Jr. in British Columbia
claims.claim: The host says her favorite fishing experience was with Don Jr., fighting back sea lions or seals in British Columbia, and that he taught her about hunting and the wild.
claims.investigative_direction: Personal anecdote recorded as said; trip dates would be needed to verify.
claims.transcript_snippet: my favorite fishing experience is actually with you, right? fighting back uh the sea lions or the seals in British Columbia.

claims.label: Host Says Jared and Ivanka's Israel Investments Explain Trump Family Silence
claims.claim: The host tells Don Jr. that if he cannot say anything she understands the ties that bind, says "they understand Jared, Ivanka and their investments in Israel and the pressure that's coming from the Zionists to simply be quiet," and says hunters know he does not believe the official account.
claims.investigative_direction: Review disclosures of Kushner and Ivanka Trump investments in Israel and any contact with Don Jr. on the Kirk case.
claims.transcript_snippet: They understand Jared, Ivanka and their investments in Israel and the pressure that's coming from the Zionists to simply be quiet

claims.label: Host Says Finkelstein Interview Will Be Released on Friday
claims.claim: The host says she sat down with Norman Finkelstein for a conversation that will be released on Friday.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare the release date of the Finkelstein interview with the host's stated Friday.
claims.transcript_snippet: have a conversation which we will be releasing on Friday uh with Norman Finkelestein.

claims.label: Host Says She Had Finkelstein on Her Show After October 7 While at the Daily Wire
claims.claim: The host says Norman Finkelstein was the reason she had him on her show shortly after October 7, when she worked at the Daily Wire, and what he told her pushed her to learn more about Gaza.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate the Daily Wire episode with Finkelstein and check its date.
claims.transcript_snippet: was the reason I had him on my show right after October 7th, sometime shortly thereafter when I was at the Daily Wire.

claims.label: Host Says She and Her Husband Travel With Priests
claims.claim: The host says that when they were in Wyoming her family traveled with priests, something she and her husband began doing a year or two ago, and explains the new relic behind her.
claims.investigative_direction: Personal statement recorded as said; no document is cited.
claims.transcript_snippet: when we were in Wyoming, we traveled with priests.

claims.label: Host Says a TPUSA Employee Dreamed of Six Snakes Around a Colleague Before the Shooting
claims.claim: The host says a young woman at Turning Point emailed her that the week before the assassination she had a vivid dream of six snakes around a colleague, and that many people dreamed of the number six.
claims.investigative_direction: Anecdote from unnamed email recorded as said; unverifiable without the email.
claims.transcript_snippet: I had a very vivid dream about so and so at the company and six snakes that were around him.

claims.label: Host Says Dreams Suggest Six People Betrayed Charlie
claims.claim: The host says she is going by a vibe that six people may have betrayed Charlie because there were so many dreams involving the number six.
